newsitem.title: UK: Glaxo down after BioChem tumbles.
newsitem.headline: Glaxo down after BioChem tumbles.

text.p: Shares in Glaxo Wellcome Plc dipped in a firm UK stock market on Wednesday, reflecting an overnight decline in BioChem Pharma shares in Canada as hopes cooled for its lamivudine drug, licensed to Glaxo.
Glaxo shares, boosted last week by promising trial results of the anti-hepatitis drug, were down 9p at 11.07-1/2 by 0758 GMT. BioChem shares dropped C$5.60 to C$26.40.

Glaxo last week said the lamivudine results were "extremely encouraging," prompting some analysts to speculate that it could have another huge seller on its hands to replace ulcer drug Zantac which faces generic competition later this year in the United States.
Yet the sharp drop in BioChem shares prompted fears that optimism over the drug may have been overdone, dealers said. "That is the story today," said one.
